title: 中国粉面几大派④完结·重庆小面：面素，料一点都不素 | China Noodle Schools P4 · Chongqing 🌶️🍜
description:
汤派、拌派、酸派、麻辣派——四碗看完，你站哪碗？评论区见。

【中国粉面几大派·第4集 完结 重庆小面】看着就一碗清汤素面，凭什么让人上瘾？秘密全在碗底：开吃前先码十几味调料——红油辣子、花椒面、涪陵榨菜、宜宾芽菜、猪油、蒜水、酱油、花生碎……花椒管麻，海椒管辣。面一烫、热汤一冲，香味瞬间起来。这碗街头小面讲究到写进了地方标准《重庆小面烹饪技术指南》，近二十道工序、十四种调料，就为二两面。四集下来，汤（兰州）、拌（武汉）、酸（柳州）、麻辣（重庆）——这就是中国粉面的四张脸。你站哪碗？

Chongqing xiaomian looks like a plain bowl of noodles — so why is it so addictive? The secret sits at the bottom: a dozen-plus seasonings laid down before you eat — chili oil, ground sichuan pepper, Fuling pickle, Yibin sprouts, lard, garlic water, soy, crushed peanuts. Pepper brings the numb, chili brings the heat; drop the noodles, pour the broth, and the aroma explodes. This street bowl is so exacting it earned an official local standard — nearly twenty steps and fourteen seasonings for one small serving. Four episodes in: soup (Lanzhou), toss (Wuhan), sour (Liuzhou), mala (Chongqing) — the four faces of Chinese noodles. Which bowl is yours?

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Food culture, not dietary advice. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
